description: Approval of details pursuant to Condition 13 (Drainage Scheme) attached to planning permission HGY/2025/3500 for a Minor Material Amendment (Section 73 application) to vary Condition 2 (Approved Plans) of planning permission HGY/2023/3351 for the demolition of the existing dwelling and erection of a replacement dwellinghouse. The approved minor material amendments comprise design revisions to a Neo-Georgian architectural approach, the introduction of a terrace above the porch entrance, stone surrounds and brick quoins, alterations to the fenestration including larger pane casement windows, and amendments to the rear elevation including new sliding doors and the removal of the ground floor bay windows.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
site_name: Oak Lawn, Compton Avenue, Hornsey, London, N6 4LB
